description.value: Ski Base is Fernie's longest-running bike and ski shop, founded in 1968 and still anchored in its downtown location. Current owners Jeff and Jane Johnson are active in local trail building and community organizations, giving the shop genuine roots in Fernie's riding culture. Touring cyclists will find a full-service repair department alongside a broad range of bikes, accessories, and touring-oriented carry gear.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ski Base is an active full-service bike and ski shop with a dedicated Service & Repair department staffed by 'highly trained, skilled mechanics' who 'can offer honest recommendations and advice on regular maintenance, upgrades and any issues you may be experiencing,' satisfying the urgency-triage criterion. The contact page corroborates the OSM address and phone number exactly. The service page states 'We book appointments for Tune Up packages only,' implying non-tune repairs are accepted as walk-ins, and the product catalog prominently features Ortlieb and Arkel touring bags, supporting a touring-parts claim.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Fernie's longest-running bike shop with a staffed repair department, touring-specific gear, and walk-in repair access — a clear and valuable resource for cycling tourists passing through the Elk Valley.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Shop prominently stocks Ortlieb Frame-Pack Top Tube Bike Bag and Arkel Saddle Bag — both touring-specific brands — alongside a general bike parts and accessories category
